collection.description: Discarded palm leaves become tiny dolls, boats, and ornaments in the hands of a patient crafter.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Discarded palm leaves become tiny dolls, boats, and ornaments in the hands of (crafter), a patient crafter.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (child) trades a doll for a handmade whistle.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A damaged doll becomes more beloved after repair.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (crafter) asks before changing a treasured design.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (newcomer), a newcomer, recognizes a familiar weaving technique.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Another appreciates the gesture but prefers something practical.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Some scraps are returned to compost rather than wasted.
